name: Raichō Hiratsuka
shortBio: Japanese philosopher, Zen practitioner, and founder of the feminist journal Seitō (Bluestocking) who fused Zen self-awakening and Nietzschean self-creation into Japan's foundational philosophy of women's inner genius.
centralQuestion: How can women recover autonomous creative subjectivity ("In the beginning, woman was the sun") while transforming state social reproduction?

keyWorks.title: In the Beginning, Woman Was the Sun (Genshi, josei wa taiyō de atta)
keyWorks.description: Founding Seitō manifesto blending Zen interiority and feminist rebellion against patriarchal alienation.
